component.name: Argus Overview
component.summary: Professional multi-boxing tool for EVE Online on Linux

description.p: Argus Overview is the complete professional multi-boxing solution for EVE Online that provides live window previews, team management, layout presets, hotkey controls, and EVE settings synchronization.

ul.li: Live window previews at configurable FPS (1-60)
Preview filter - quick search by character name
Keyboard window control (1-9 keys)
System tray integration with minimize-to-tray
One-click import of all EVE windows
Auto-discovery of new EVE clients
Per-character global hotkeys
Character and team management
Layout presets with auto-tiling (2x2, 3x1, Main+Sides, etc.)
Visual activity alerts (red flash detection)
EVE settings synchronization between characters
Multi-monitor support
Low power mode for background operation

description.p: Cross-platform release with intel and coverage improvements

ul.li: Cross-platform support: single unified codebase for Linux and Windows
Platform abstraction layer (X11 + Win32)
Intel channel parser with threat level assessment and alert sounds
CI/CD for Linux AppImage and Windows PyInstaller builds
Test coverage improved to 96% (1892 tests)
Overall coverage improved from 93% to 94% (1827 tests)
Added Python 3.12 skipif decorators for PySide6 segfault-prone tests

description.p: CI build fixes and version unification

ul.li: Resolved Linux AppImage build failures with xvfb-run wrapper
Unified version display across all UI components

description.p: Intel alert sounds and Windows build support

ul.li: Four new audio alert files for different threat levels
Windows PyInstaller spec file and CI/CD workflow
Test coverage improved to 93% (1798 tests)
Single unified codebase supporting both Linux and Windows
Platform abstraction layer with clean separation (base, linux, windows)
Platform-specific dependencies via extras (pip install argus-overview[linux])
Windows version now built from same codebase (separate repo archived)
Added comprehensive User Guide
Added Architecture documentation
Working Flatpak manifest with X11 tools from source
Fixed unused imports and sorted import blocks in tests
Fixed flaky window activation test
Updated GitHub Actions to v6
Test coverage at 97%

description.p: Preview Filter and Keyboard Control edition

ul.li: Preview filter - quick search by character name
Keyboard window control (1-9 keys)
Alert detection 400x faster
Fixed CPU busy loop (15-20% reduction)
Fixed memory leak (~600x reduction)
Security hardening throughout
